lines.text: You can't give a powerful new idea to an audience,
unless you can learn how to explain it.
Each step builds on what the listener already knows,
and metaphors and examples help show how the idea is pieced together.
But if explanation is building a brand new idea in someone's mind,
persuasion is something a little more.
Persuasion means convincing an audience that their way of seeing something, their perspective, isn't quite right.
That means taking down the parts of their thinking that aren't working and rebuilding something better.
Many people are obsessed with maximizing choice.
She showed how the power of storytelling can help persuade an audience of a new idea.
Her goal was to change the way they thought about creative genius.
Gilbert used her brilliance as a storyteller to persuade her audience of this idea.
She also showed them the term genius was viewed differently in history.
It wasn't always thought of as a thing a person was.
It used to be thought of as something that came to them.
